title: How Sink Drainage Works: The P-Trap Principle
description: Every functional sink relies on a carefully engineered hydraulic seal known as the P-trap. Understanding how this simple plumbing component works is essential for every plumbing professional. The primary function of the P-trap is to retain a specific volume of water inside its curved bend after every use. This standing water acts as an impermeable physical barrier that stops hazardous sewer gases, foul odors, and insects from rising up through the waste arm and entering the living space. Proper installation and maintaining the correct trap seal depth are critical for safe, sanitary drainage system design.
